title: Blood and Thunder
lyrics:
[00:13.59]I think that someone is trying to kill me
[00:18.81]Infecting my blood and destroying my mind
[00:23.97]No man of the flesh could ever stop me
[00:29.21]The fight for this fish is a fight to the death
[00:32.16]White whale
[00:34.80]Holy grail
[00:42.12]White whale
[00:44.70]Holy grail
[00:54.40]What remorseless emperor commands me?
[00:59.71]I no longer govern my soul
[01:04.75]I am completely immersed in darkness
[01:09.82]As I turn my body away from the Sun
[01:12.90]White whale
[01:15.50]Holy grail
[01:22.83]White whale
[01:25.47]Holy grail
[02:15.45]Split your lungs with blood and thunder
[02:20.24]When you see the white whale
[02:25.80]Break your backs and crack your oars, men
[02:30.50]If you wish to prevail
[02:35.77]This ivory leg is what propels me
[02:40.62]Harpoons thrust in the sky
[02:46.30]Aim directly for his crooked brow
[02:51.18]And look him straight in the eye
[02:56.44]White whale
[02:59.05]Holy grail
[03:06.30]White whale
[03:08.90]Holy grail
